<ic>Resupply the army of the Hounds of Glory.<br><br>''Proposed by Semmerholm, seconded by Weirwater.''</ic>

===Overview===
* Provide [[Casualties#Emergency Resupply|emergency resupply]] to the army of the [[Dawn_military_concerns#The_Hounds_of_Glory|Hounds of Glory]].
* Passed by 27 votes to 0
* Funded at 50 Thrones

===Date===
* Summer 377YE (Event Three 2013).

===Cost===
* [[Casualties#Resupply|Standard resupply costs]] apply.

===Campaign Outcome===
* Unlimited resupply of the Granite Pillar is authorised by the [[Senate]] until end of Spring 378.

===Progress===
====Autumn Equinox====
* 33 wains of Weirwood supplied by Floree De Rondelle, General of the Hounds of Glory
* Army strength of the Hounds of Glory increased

===Constitution===
When no limitations are placed on the extent or duration of Senate authorisation to resupply an army, the assumption is that the maximum possible limits apply; the senator may supply any amount of mithril or weirwood for up to a year after the motion is passed.
